component.title: Empty state
component.purpose: The shared treatment for a surface with nothing in it yet, which always offers the single action that would fill it rather than describing the concept.

states.description: Nothing exists yet, with the action that creates the first thing.
An empty region inside a larger populated page.

claims.statement: An empty state that has a creating action always shows it as the dominant element.
claims.rationale: An empty state without an action is a dead end dressed as a design.

claims.statement: Empty is perceivably distinct from an error and from a still-loading region.
claims.rationale: Emptiness read as failure is the most common false alarm in a console.

claims.statement: Where empty means nothing needs attention, the copy says so plainly instead of showing zeroed figures.
The empty treatment holds in both themes.
